mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 2.0% over 3 months signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising corporate borrowing costs and reducing earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment rate and sustained non-farm payrolls growth indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS grows by at least 100k in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts combined with rising retail sales signal late-cycle demand saturation, triggering interest rate hikes and overvaluation concerns that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 850.0 and RSAFS growth is above 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through lower earnings expectations.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 95.0 for 3 consecutive months yet S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850.0 units signals robust consumer confidence and construction activity, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 850.0 for 3 consecutive months yet S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate rises indicate monetary tightening coinciding with economic weakness, pressuring equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% during low inflation environments creates favorable liquidity conditions that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months.
